summary: Worldwide search for citizenship- or residence-by-investment routes missing from programs.csv, run in five regional slices (Europe/EEA; Western Balkans, Caucasus, Eastern Europe and Central Asia; Gulf, North and sub-Saharan Africa; Asia and the Pacific; Caribbean, Latin America and Canadian provinces). 42 programmes added, each resting on a stored primary text (law, gazette, or the running agency's page); 92 sources stored with sha256 and a ledger entry. Many launch dates stay empty because the first text that made investing a route was not found (decision 14). Weaker candidates (Slovakia, Botswana, Ghana, Nigeria, Egypt property residence, Bangladesh, Maldives, Kazakhstan, Turkey property residence, Serbia, Albania, Chile and others) are in leads with what is missing. Quote check: all quotes found verbatim in the stored files except the Russian decree (scanned; quotes from OCR, checked by eye) and Korean annex tables (cell lines joined). Cleaned 2026-10-10 after review: 12 programmes dropped as out of scope under decision 15 (refined); launch dates resting on unstored texts emptied; dates corrected or removed as listed in the review.

sources.notes: Promulgation decree dated 01.03.2016; in force on the eighth day after publication in the Official Gazette (publication date not read). Scanned text layer with OCR errors (e.g. 'elana' for 'člana').

sources.title: Zakon o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o strancima (Skupština Crne Gore, 31. decembar 2025)

sources.title: The Migration Code of the Republic of Azerbaijan (approved by Law No. 713-IVG of 2 July 2013), English text as amended

sources.title: Temporary residence of foreigners and stateless persons in the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan (service page)
sources.publisher: State Migration Service of the Republic of Azerbaijan

sources.title: According to the new amendment made to the Migration Code, a new category of case has been added to the conditions for obtaining a temporary residence permit

sources.title: Закон Республики Беларусь от 4 января 2010 г. № 105-З «О правовом положении иностранных граждан и лиц без гражданства в Республике Беларусь» (действующая редакция)

sources.publisher: Albanian State Police (asp.gov.al)

sources.title: Zakon o strancima (Sl. glasnik RS, br. 24/2018, 31/2019 i 62/2023), prečišćen tekst
sources.publisher: Paragraf Lex (paragraf.rs)

sources.notes: Commercial legal database copy (official site pravno-informacioni-sistem.rs not tried); kept in raw/local. No programme row (see leads).

sources.title: Zákon č. 404/2011 Z. z. o pobyte cudzincov a o zmene a doplnení niektorých zákonov (časová verzia účinná od 1. 7. 2025 do 14. 7. 2025)
sources.publisher: Slov-Lex (Ministerstvo spravodlivosti Slovenskej republiky)
sources.covers: Slovak Act on Residence of Foreigners, consolidated version valid 1-14 July 2025: temporary residence for business (§ 22, no investment amount; business plan assessed by the Ministry of Economy, § 33), permanent residence for five years "if it is in the interest of the Slovak Republic" (§ 43(1)(e)), certified by a central state authority (§ 45(5)), with a 30-day decision for people representing or working for a significant foreign investor (§ 45(7)).
sources.notes: Checked to see whether Slovakia has an investor residence route. None found in the Act: no investment amount appears anywhere in it. The European Commission (SWD(2019) 5, intl-ec-swd-2019-5) classes Slovakia as requiring a "very high investment (over 5 million)" for permanent residence; that threshold is not in the Act and presumably sits in the practice of the certifying ministry under § 43(1)(e). The zakonypreludi.sk mirror returned a Cloudflare check and was not used.

sources.title: Llei 9/2012, del 31 de maig, de modificació de la Llei qualificada d’immigració (BOPA núm. 30, any 24, 27.6.2012)
sources.publisher: Consell General del Principat d’Andorra (copy of the Butlletí Oficial del Principat d’Andorra)
sources.covers: Andorra’s qualified immigration law of 2012, replacing the 2002/2008 immigration law and the passive-residence law 17/2006: residence without gainful activity (arts. 95-97) conditional on investing at least EUR 400,000 in Andorran assets, including a EUR 50,000 unremunerated deposit (EUR 10,000 per dependant) with the INAF; residence for professionals with international projection (arts. 98-99); in force on publication.
sources.notes: BOPA pages as published on the Consell General site (PDF pp. 1-31 = BOPA pp. 2609-2639). The first BOPA page also carries an unrelated edict (Andorra-Argentina tax information agreement).

sources.title: Llei 10/2018, del 17 de maig, qualificada de modificació de la Llei 9/2012, del 31 de maig, de modificació de la Llei qualificada d’immigració (BOPA núm. 36, 13.6.2018)
sources.publisher: Consell General del Principat d’Andorra (copy of the Butlletí Oficial del Principat d’Andorra)
sources.covers: 2018 amendment of the immigration law: restates art. 96 (EUR 400,000 investment in Andorran assets; EUR 50,000 and EUR 10,000 per dependant deposits) and extends the deposit to professionals with international projection and residents for scientific, cultural and sporting reasons; in force the day after publication.
sources.notes: 9 pages. Only the passive-residence provisions were read for this pass.

sources.title: Informe de la Comissió legislativa d’Economia al Projecte de llei de continuïtat i consolidació de les mesures per al creixement sostenible
sources.publisher: Consell General del Principat d’Andorra
sources.covers: Text of the bill as adopted by the Economy Committee (meetings 9-19 January 2026) and sent to plenary: art. 10 replaces art. 96 of Llei 9/2012 (investment for residence without gainful activity raised to EUR 1,000,000, or EUR 400,000 if invested in the Housing Fund; each property bought must exceed EUR 800,000; EUR 50,000 plus EUR 12,000 per dependant paid to the AFA as a non-refundable payment to the State).
sources.notes: A committee report, not the enacted law. The bill became Llei 2/2026, del 22 de gener (named on the government form and-govern-t2g005-2026); the BOPA text of Llei 2/2026 was not obtained, so the figures are as approved by the committee. Industry and press reports (not stored) describe the same figures as enacted.

sources.title: Compromís d’inversió en actius andorrans (form T2 G005, version 15/05/2026)
sources.publisher: Govern d’Andorra
sources.covers: Official form by which an applicant for residence without gainful activity commits to make the art. 96.1 investment within six months; lists the asset types and cites the applicable law, including Llei 2/2026, del 22 de gener, and the Decree of 12-11-2025 approving the regulation on residence without work.
sources.notes: Confirms the route is operating in 2026 and that Llei 2/2026 is in force. Prints no amounts.

sources.publisher: Government of South Africa (gov.za)
sources.covers: Original text: s. 15 business permit for foreigners investing the prescribed financial or capital contribution; s. 27(c) permanent residence for those establishing a business with the prescribed contribution; s. 55 commencement by proclamation.
sources.notes: Scanned gazette with an OCR text layer of poor quality; quotes chosen from legible passages and should be checked against the page image. Commencement is by presidential proclamation (date not in this document). Later amended (business permit renamed business visa by the Immigration Amendment Acts 2004/2011).

sources.title: Application for a Business Visa (South African Embassy, Copenhagen)
sources.publisher: Department of International Relations and Cooperation (DIRCO), South African Embassy Copenhagen
sources.covers: Requirements for a South African business visa (new and existing business): accountant certificate that at least R5 000 000 in cash (or cash and capital contribution) from outside the Republic is available to be invested; 60% local staff undertaking.
sources.notes: Undated form; upload path dated 2025/12. Restates the Immigration Act s. 15 as amended and the ministerial determination of the R5 million contribution (2014 notice not stored).

sources.title: Zambia Development Agency Act, 2006 (No. 11 of 2006)
sources.publisher: Government of Zambia (copy via ZambiaLII / Laws.Africa)
sources.covers: Original Act as published: s. 65(1) an investor investing at least USD 250,000 and employing a minimum number of persons is entitled to a self employment permit or resident permit.
sources.notes: Scanned publication document with OCR. Assented 12 May 2006; the bracketed date 19 May 2006 is printed under the long title; s. 1 says it comes into force on a date appointed by statutory instrument (not read). The OCR reads the employment minimum as two hundred persons; a later amendment (reported in secondary material as ten persons) was not read. Whether the 2006 Act is still in force (it may have been replaced by later investment legislation) was not checked.

sources.title: Immigration and Deportation Act, 2010 (Act 18 of 2010), as at 7 June 2016
sources.publisher: Government of Zambia (copy via ZambiaLII / Laws.Africa)

sources.notes: CC BY 4.0 (Laws.Africa). Assented 13 Apr 2010, published 16 Apr 2010, commenced 17 Sep 2010 by commencement order; amended by Act 19 of 2016. The prescribed amount is not in the Act.

sources.notes: Undated page retrieved 2026-10-10. Gives no investment amount.

sources.title: Investment and residence permit guidelines

sources.notes: State-owned newspaper, 2012; attributes the figures to ZIA procedures. Secondary: thresholds may have changed (ZIA was replaced by ZIDA in 2020). Stored locally, not for redistribution.

sources.title: مرسوم سلطاني رقم ١٢ / ٢٠٠٦ في شأن نظام تملك غير العمانيين للعقارات في المجمعات السياحية المتكاملة (Royal Decree 12/2006 on the ownership of real estate by non-Omanis in integrated tourism complexes)

programs.name: Colombia investor visa (Visa M Inversionista, Resolución 5477 de 2022 art. 79; formerly visa de residente por inversión extranjera directa and visa de migrante como inversor inmobiliario)
programs.notes: Visa for a foreigner who has registered foreign direct investment above 650 monthly legal minimum wages with the Banco de la República, or bought real estate worth at least 350 minimum wages (since Oct 2022 both give a 3-year M visa; five years as holder can lead to a permanent R visa). Under Res. 6045/2017 the 650-wage FDI route gave a resident visa directly and the 350-wage property route a migrant visa. The company-owner visa (M Socio o Propietario: paid-in capital or registered investment in a company of at least 100 minimum wages) is a threshold on a company's money, out of scope under decision 15 (refined), and not recorded. Amounts are in minimum wages and are not converted. 'launched' left empty: the route predates the earliest text read (2017); Res. 5512/2015, 1980/2014 and earlier decrees were not read.

programs.name: Curaçao investor residence permit ('Investors permit 2014', Richtlijnen Investors permit 2014 under art. 7 Landsverordening Toelating en Uitzetting)
programs.notes: Residence permit for high net worth investors: ANG 500,000 gives a 3-year permit, ANG 750,000 a 5-year permit and ANG 1,500,000 an indefinite permit; purpose includes purchase of real property or a business investment. The 2014 decree (in force 1 Oct 2014) replaced a Ministerial Decree of 3 August 2009 (not read), so an investor scheme existed earlier; 'launched' left empty. Curaçao is a country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands; Dutch citizenship after residence is not part of this decree. Current status not confirmed (press reports a 2025 revamp; not read).

programs.name: Ecuador temporary residence visa as investor (visa de residencia temporal inversionista, Ley Orgánica de Movilidad Humana arts. 59-60)
programs.notes: Two-year temporary residence for a foreigner who holds a bank deposit for at least 730 days, real estate, or shares in an Ecuadorian company, each worth at least 100 unified basic wages (salarios básicos unificados), or a contract with the State. Amounts in basic wages, not converted. 'launched' left empty: the Ley Orgánica de Movilidad Humana (2017) and its predecessor (Ley de Extranjería) were not read. The portal publishes monthly 'Atenciones' for the procedure since 2019, not defined.

programs.name: Honduras residence as investor (residente inversionista, Ley de Migración y Extranjería; Reglamento arts. 22, 33 and 35)
programs.notes: Residence for a foreigner investing at least USD 50,000 (or the equivalent in lempiras), with a feasibility study, a USD 5,000 central-bank deposit guaranteeing the investment, registration in the Registro de Inversionistas and a USD 300 fee. 'launched' left empty: the law (Decreto 208-2003) and its regulation were not read. The requirements sheet is from Dec 2022; current status not confirmed.

programs.name: Nicaragua residence as investor (residente inversionista, Ley 761 Ley General de Migración y Extranjería arts. 32, 35; nationality for investor residents art. 55)
programs.notes: Investor residence for foreigners who invest capital in any lawful economic activity, or in state or national financial-institution securities and bonds; investor status certified by MIFIC, requirements set by regulation (Decreto 31-2012, not read). Investor residents who have set up an industry or activity contributing to development may naturalise after two years of permanent residence. No amount in the law; press and industry cite USD 30,000 (not confirmed from an official text). 'launched' left empty: earlier migration laws were not read. In scope under decision 15 (refined): the law leaves the amount to regulation, so the investment rule is recorded with the amount unset.

programs.name: Peru residence as investor (calidad migratoria de residencia 'Inversionista', Decreto Legislativo 1350 art. 29.2(f); Reglamento D.S. 007-2017-IN art. 86)
programs.notes: Residence status for a foreigner who establishes, develops or manages a lawful investment; the law leaves the amount to the regulation, and Migraciones requires an investment of at least S/ 500,000 made by one international transfer through a supervised bank, for a 365-day renewable stay. 'launched' left empty: an investor status existed before DL 1350 (in force 1 March 2017) under the 1991 Ley de Extranjería and a 2012 procedures text (a 2018 Migraciones appeal decision mentions a US$30,000 investment under D.S. 003-2012-IN; not stored because it names the applicant), and those texts were not read. No counts found.

programs.name: Paraguay permanent residence as investor via SUACE (Ley 6984/2022 'De Migraciones'; Constancia de Inversionista Extranjero, Ley 4986/2013; 'Paraguay Investor Pass' since 2026)
programs.notes: A foreigner who obtains the Ministry of Industry and Commerce's foreign-investor certificate through the SUACE single window can apply directly for permanent residence (investor category) under Ley 6984/2022, valid 10 years and renewable. Until April 2026 the certificate required a USD 70,000 investment within two years and 5 formal jobs; Resolución MIC 0283/2026 (branded Paraguay Investor Pass) added financial instruments (USD 200,000, held two years), real estate for economic use (USD 200,000) and tourism (USD 150,000). 'launched' left empty: Ley 6984/2022 and the earlier law (Ley 978/1996) were not read, and Paraguay's migration agency site did not respond.

programs.name: El Salvador naturalisation and permanent residence for investors and donors in government programmes (Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería arts. 156(5) and 152(13); 'Freedom Visa')
programs.notes: D.L. 918 of 20 Dec 2023 (D.O. 9 Jan 2024) added art. 156(5): foreigners who meet government programmes for attracting investors or donors who inject capital in legal tender may apply for naturalisation. 'launched' left empty: D.L. 918 itself is not stored, so its in-force date (Salvadoran decrees usually state one) cannot be checked; the publication date of 9 Jan 2024 is kept as a 'legal' event. D.L. 286 of 2025 (in force 13 May 2025, eight days after publication on 5 May; counted by us) lets people joining central-government programmes obtain permanent residence directly, with no absence limit and a USD 690 fee. The press reports the 'Freedom Visa' (launched 7 Dec 2023 with Tether, before the law was published): USD 1 million donation in bitcoin or USDT, 1,000 places a year; no official text of the programme's requirements or any count was found. Status not confirmed.

programs.name: Sri Lanka Golden Paradise Visa (Golden Paradise Residence Visa Program; 10-year residence visa for investors with a foreign-currency deposit)
programs.notes: Run by the Department of Immigration and Emigration under the Immigrants and Emigrants Act. Founding text is internal circular 01/2022/VISA of 25 May 2022 (no in-force date stated, so launched = circular date): deposit of US$100,000 in a Golden Paradise account at a licensed bank, US$50,000 to be kept from the second year, 10-year visa for the investor, spouse and children under 16, visa fee US$200 per person per year (US$2,000 for 10 years); the money may be used for approved investments, condominium purchase, leases or Sri Lanka Development Bonds. The current official page asks for US$200,000 with up to 50% withdrawable after a year; the date and instrument of that increase were not found. No official counts found.

programs.name: China permanent residence for foreign direct investors (外国人在中国永久居留审批管理办法 2004, arts. 6(1) and 7)
programs.notes: The 2004 Measures (MPS/MFA Order 74, approved by the State Council on 13 Dec 2003, promulgated and in force 15 Aug 2004) give permanent residence ("green card") to foreigners who have invested directly in China, with stable investment for three consecutive years and a good tax record, provided paid-in registered capital totals at least US$500,000 in encouraged sectors or in the western region and poverty counties, US$1 million in the central region, or US$2 million anywhere. Cards valid 10 years for adults; holders must spend at least 3 months a year in China. Current status not checked; no official counts by route found.

programs.name: Macau temporary residence for investors (Decreto-Lei 14/95/M; Regulamento Administrativo 3/2005: relevant investments, investment plans and, 2005-2007, property purchase)
programs.notes: Run by the Macao Trade and Investment Promotion Institute (IPIM). DL 14/95/M (in force 1 Apr 1995) let holders of relevant investments settle, including funds of at least MOP 1 million placed permanently in real estate or other productive assets (MOP 500,000 in property for Hong Kong retirees); permits for 3 years, renewable. RA 3/2005 (in force 4 Apr 2005) replaced it with residence for relevant investments or investment plans and a separate property-purchase route (property of at least MOP 1 million bought without credit, plus MOP 500,000 on term deposit and a degree); RA 7/2007 suspended the property route from 4 Apr 2007. The managerial and technical personnel routes of the same regime are talent routes, not in scope (technical personnel moved to Law 7/2023 from 1 Jul 2023). 'launched' left empty: DL 14/95/M refers to investor residence applications pending under the earlier DL 3/84/M, so investor residence predates 1995, and DL 3/84/M is not stored. IPIM publishes yearly counts; new major-investment applications have been few since 2020 (0-6 a year).

programs.name: India Permanent Residency Status (PRS) for foreign investors
programs.notes: Approved by the Union Cabinet on 31 Aug 2016: a 10-year multiple-entry residency status, renewable for 10 years, for foreign investors who bring in at least Rs 10 crore within 18 months or Rs 25 crore within 36 months and create at least 20 jobs for resident Indians each financial year; holders may buy one residential property and family members may work and study. 'launched' left empty: the only official text found is the Cabinet approval release of 31 Aug 2016, not a founding text in force; the implementing instrument (visa manual or MHA order) is not stored; the implementing visa-manual provisions, any start date of applications and any counts of PRS granted were not found. Reports say Pakistani nationals are excluded (not in the stored text).

programs.name: Viet Nam investor visas and temporary residence cards ĐT1-ĐT3 (Law 47/2014/QH13 as amended by Law 51/2019/QH14, art. 8(7a)-(7c), arts. 9, 38)
programs.notes: Since 1 Jul 2020 (Law 51/2019/QH14) foreign investors are classed by capital contributed: ĐT1 VND 100 billion or more (or priority sectors/areas set by the Government) with a temporary residence card of up to 10 years; ĐT2 VND 50-100 billion (or encouraged sectors) up to 5 years; ĐT3 VND 3-50 billion up to 3 years; ĐT4 under VND 3 billion (visa only, no minimum). Before, Law 47/2014/QH13 (in force 1 Jan 2015, legal_basis) had a single investor visa class without amounts (original text not stored; stated in the consolidated text's footnotes only as the amended items). Included under decision 15 as business residence with stated minimum amounts; ĐT4 has none. No route to permanent residence through investment in this law. No official counts by class found.

programs.name: Sarawak-Malaysia My Second Home (S-MM2H) programme
programs.notes: Separate programme run by the Sarawak Ministry of Tourism, Creative Industry and Performing Arts (Sarawak controls immigration into the state), distinct from the federal MM2H (mys-mm2h). Under the guide amended 31 Jul 2025 (rules effective 1 Jan 2025 per the minister): applicants aged 30+, a mandatory RM500,000 fixed deposit in a panel bank in Sarawak (RM250,000 minimum balance to be kept; up to 50% withdrawable after a year for a house, car, medical or education costs in Sarawak) and, in addition, a pension or offshore income of RM10,000 a month (RM15,000 with dependants) or savings of RM100,000 (RM200,000); 5+5-year social visit pass; at least 30 days a year in Sarawak. Deposit plus income, like the federal MM2H. Launch year not found in a stored document. The minister gave participant counts for the top 10 nationalities (China 391, UK 350 ...), not recorded because the stock/flow basis is not stated.

programs.name: Korea residence (F-2) and permanent residence (F-5) for foreign direct investors under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act (Immigration Act Enforcement Decree, annex 1-2 item 24(라), annex 1-3 item 3)
programs.notes: Separate from the real-estate and public-project investment immigration schemes (F-2 차; kor-real-estate-immigration, kor-public-investment-immigration). A foreign investor under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act gets residence (F-2) after investing US$500,000 and holding corporate-investor (D-8) status for 3 years, or after investing US$300,000 and employing 2 Koreans; permanent residence (F-5) after investing US$500,000 and employing 5 Koreans. Investment plus employment conditions; based on the current decree only. The date these items were introduced was not traced (launched empty). No official counts by item found.

programs.name: Fiji Investor Permit (Immigration Regulations 2007, ss. 39-41)
programs.notes: Residence and work permit for foreign shareholders, owners or representatives of a company registered in Fiji, issued by the Ministry of Immigration under ss. 39-41 of the Immigration Regulations 2007: investment threshold of $300,000 (currency printed as "$"; Fijian dollars presumed, the Ministry's other amounts are FJD) unless the Ministry of Trade grants a waiver; 3 years approved in principle (1 year issued first). No route to citizenship. The regulations (and when the amount was set) were not obtained, so launched is empty; industry sites cite older thresholds (FJD 50,000 / 250,000), not checked. Representatives of a foreign shareholder company also qualify, so the money need not be the applicant's own.

programs.name: Nepal residential visa for investors (US$100,000 in the industrial sector)
programs.notes: Nepal grants a residential visa (issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs, renewed by the Department of Immigration) to, among others, investors who invest at least US$100,000 at one time in the industrial sector. Source is a Nepalese embassy information page; the Immigration Rules 2051 (1994) and any amendments that set the category were not read, so launched is empty. Annual renewal and other conditions are reported by secondary sources only. No counts found.

programs.name: Ukraine immigration permit for foreign investors (Закон «Про імміграцію» 2001, ст. 4 ч. 2 п. 3: investment of at least USD 100,000, within the immigration quota)
programs.notes: The Law on Immigration (No. 2491-III, adopted 7 June 2001) lists, among the categories that may receive an immigration permit (permanent residence) within the yearly immigration quota, persons who made a foreign investment in Ukraine's economy in convertible currency of at least USD 100,000. The clause is in the first edition and in the current text (reworded in 2016 and 2023). Launched = entry into force 07.08.2001 per the Rada's document card (the law enters into force one month after publication; first published 07.07.2001). Quota sizes and the number of permits granted to investors were not found. Status left empty: the law is in force, but whether the route operates under martial law was not checked.

programs.name: Georgia investment residence permit (Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, art. 15(h); unlimited residence under art. 15(k))
programs.notes: The 2014 Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons (No 2045, in force 1 September 2014) created an investment residence permit for an investment of at least GEL 300,000. Law No 4741 of 30 May 2019 (published 5.6.2019) raised the threshold to USD 300,000 (in GEL), added real estate worth more than USD 300,000 as a basis, made the permit 5 years, and allowed an unlimited (permanent) residence permit after 5 years subject to company turnover (USD 50,000/100,000/120,000 in years 1/2/3-5) or keeping the property. Whether the 2005 Law on the Legal Status of Aliens already had an investor ground was not checked. The separate short-term permit for property owners is geo-property-residence. No official counts were found. The stored 2015-05 and 2019-05 English versions print 'This Law shall enter into force on 1 January 2014', a translation error (the law was signed 5 March 2014; art. 74 of the 2014 text and later versions give 1 September 2014).

programs.name: Georgia short-term residence permit for owners of real property (Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, art. 15(j))
programs.notes: Law No 3602 of 8 May 2015 (published 15.5.2015) added a short-term residence permit, renewable yearly, for an alien who owns non-agricultural real property in Georgia with a market value above USD 35,000 (in GEL), valued by an accredited assessor; raised to USD 100,000 by Law No 4741 of 2019 and to USD 150,000 by Law No 863 of 26 June 2025. 'launched' left empty: Law No 3602 itself is not stored, so its in-force date is unknown; its publication date (15.5.2015, from the history note of the stored consolidated text) is kept as a 'legal' event. The 2019 and 2025 dates are likewise publication dates standing in for amending laws that are not stored. Legal basis is the 2014 Law's entry into force. The permit lapses when ownership ends. No official counts were found.

programs.name: Russia residence permit for foreign investors without a temporary residence permit (Federal Law 115-FZ art. 8(2)(17); Government Decree No. 2573 of 31.12.2022)
programs.notes: Government Decree No. 2573 of 31 December 2022 (in force 11 January 2023) sets four alternative criteria under which a foreign investor gets a residence permit (вид на жительство) without first holding a temporary residence permit: RUB 15 million invested in socially significant regional projects in the 3 preceding years; a company founded by the applicant (sole participant) that has operated 2 years and pays at least RUB 4 million a year in taxes and contributions; RUB 30 million invested in a Russian company operating at least 3 years that paid at least RUB 6 million in taxes; or new-build real estate with total cadastral value of at least RUB 50 million (Moscow), 20 million (Far Eastern Federal District) or 25 million (elsewhere) held for one year. The decree implements subparagraph 17 of para 2 of art. 8 of Federal Law 115-FZ; when that subparagraph was added was not established, so legal_basis is empty. No official counts found.

programs.name: Uzbekistan residence permit for foreigners buying real estate (Presidential Decree UP-5611 of 5 January 2019, para 5 and Annex 6)
programs.notes: Decree UP-5611 (in force 06.01.2019) gives citizens of the countries listed in its Annex 6 the right to a residence permit on purchase of real estate worth at least USD 400,000 in Tashkent city and region, USD 200,000 in Samarkand, Bukhara, Namangan, Andijan, Fergana and Khorezm regions, and USD 100,000 in Karakalpakstan and other regions. Decree UP-101 of 8 April 2022 cut the Tashkent threshold to USD 300,000. A separate 2025 'golden visa' (reported USD 250,000 investment) and a 2019 investor residence rule were not confirmed from primary texts (see leads). No official counts found.

programs.name: Azerbaijan temporary and permanent residence by investment, real estate, deposit or securities (Migration Code arts. 45.1.2-45.1.3-2 and 52.1.2-52.1.5)
programs.notes: The Migration Code (approved by Law No. 713-IVQ of 2 July 2013) grants temporary residence to foreigners who invest at least AZN 500,000 in the economy (permit up to 3 years, renewable for 3), own real estate (or bank funds) of at least AZN 100,000, hold a fixed-term bank deposit of AZN 100,000 or government securities of AZN 100,000 (securities ground added in 2023), and permanent residence for AZN 500,000 investment or AZN 200,000 in real estate, deposits or securities. The separate route for heads/majority founders of foreign-invested companies (paid-up company capital of AZN 50,000 or 100,000 since 16 January 2024) is a threshold on a company's money, out of scope under decision 15 (refined), and not recorded. An earlier English text (file dated 2018) already has the AZN 500,000 and AZN 100,000 grounds; the date these grounds were introduced was not established (the Code's amendment footnotes are not in the stored files), so launched is empty. No official counts found.

programs.name: Belarus permanent residence permit for foreign investors (Law No. 105-З of 4 January 2010, art. 53)
programs.notes: Article 53 of the Law on the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens and Stateless Persons lets foreigners who invested in Belarus at least fifteen thousand base units obtain a permanent residence permit without the usual five years of temporary residence. The Interior Ministry's migration head said in January 2024 (Interfax) that EUR 150,000 is the threshold and that 3-4 permits go to investors a year. The original 2010 wording, and when the investor ground and the base-unit threshold were introduced, were not read, so launched is empty.

programs.name: Montenegro temporary residence for owners of real property (Zakon o strancima, art. 54 (2016 text) / art. 56 (2018 law); EUR 150,000 minimum from the 2025 amendment)
programs.notes: Montenegro's Law on Foreigners allows temporary residence 'for the use and disposal of rights to real property' a foreigner owns in Montenegro (houses, villas, flats, hospitality and business premises). Until 2026 the law set no minimum value (a 2015 decree on the type and value of such property, Sl. list CG 61/15, was repealed by the 2016 amendment). The amendment adopted on 31 December 2025 requires proof that the property's real-estate transfer tax base is at least EUR 150,000 (EU/EEA/Swiss nationals exempt); media reports of EUR 200,000 are not what the adopted text says. The route's origin (before 2015) was not established, so launched is empty; the 2026 entry-into-force date (eighth day after publication) is not stored, since the Službeni list publication is not stored, so the EUR 150,000 rule has no valid_from. Separate from the closed citizenship programme mne-cbi.

programs.name: Andorra residence without gainful activity by investment in Andorran assets (residència sense activitat lucrativa, "passive residence"; Llei 9/2012 qualificada d’immigració, arts. 95-96)
programs.notes: Launched by Llei 9/2012 (approved 31 May 2012), in force on publication in BOPA no. 30 of 27 June 2012: the main holder must invest at least EUR 400,000 in Andorran property, company shares, debt or financial instruments of Andorran entities, Andorran public debt or unremunerated deposits, including a EUR 50,000 unremunerated deposit (EUR 10,000 per dependant) with the INAF, and live in Andorra at least 90 days a year without working. Earlier passive-residence laws (1995 law, Llei 17/2006) required means and a guarantee deposit but no investment; they were repealed by Llei 9/2012 and were not stored. Restated in 2018 (Llei 10/2018). An intermediate rise to EUR 600,000 reported by industry sources was not found in an official text. Llei 2/2026, del 22 de gener (named in the stored Govern form), changed these rules; the stored committee report on the bill gives EUR 1,000,000 (EUR 400,000 if put into the Housing Fund) and non-refundable payments of EUR 50,000/12,000, but the enacted text as published in the BOPA is not stored, so no 2026 rules are recorded yet. No official count of passive-residence permits was found (the statistics office’s permit bulletins do not separate them).

programs.name: South Africa business visa (formerly business permit) and permanent residence for business investors (Immigration Act 13 of 2002, ss. 15 and 27(c))
programs.notes: A foreigner who establishes or invests in a business in South Africa and invests the prescribed financial or capital contribution gets a business visa (permit until the 2011 amendments) for himself and his immediate family; s. 27(c) gives permanent residence on the same basis. The contribution is R5 000 000 in cash (or cash plus new machinery), certified by an accountant, with an undertaking that 60% of staff will be South African; it can be reduced or waived for businesses in the national interest. 'launched' left empty: the Act came into force on a date fixed by a proclamation that is not stored; its Gazette publication (31 May 2002) is kept as a 'legal' event. Business and investor permits under the earlier Aliens Control Act 1991 were not researched. The 2014 ministerial notice setting R5 million and any earlier amount were not stored. Not in scope: the s. 27(f) financially independent permanent residence (net worth, not an investment). No official counts found.

programs.name: Zambia investor's permit (Immigration and Deportation Act 2010 s. 29; Zambia Development Agency Act 2006 s. 65)
programs.notes: A foreigner who invests the prescribed financial or capital contribution in a business (or holds a ZDA investment licence) gets an investor's permit (Immigration and Deportation Act 2010 s. 29); after more than three years on it he may get a residence permit. The ZDA Act 2006 s. 65(1) entitles an investor who invests at least USD 250,000 and employs a minimum of two hundred persons (as printed) to a self-employment or residence permit. 'launched' left empty: the ZDA Act, the earliest official text found tying a stated investment to residence, came into force by a statutory instrument that is not stored; the date printed under its long title (19 May 2006) is kept as a 'legal' event; the 1965 Immigration Act was not researched. The current prescribed amount is not in the Acts read: secondary sources give USD 250,000 for a new business and USD 150,000 to join an existing one, which was not confirmed officially. Whether the ZDA Act 2006 is still in force was not checked, so status is left empty. No official counts found.

programs.name: Zimbabwe Investor Residence Permit
programs.notes: The Department of Immigration issues an Investor Residence Permit on a project proposal, banking history and proof of funds available for transfer. Investment thresholds come only from a 2012 Herald article citing Zimbabwe Investment Authority procedures (US$1 million for permanent residence on application; US$300,000 sole venture or US$100,000 joint venture for a three-year residence permit leading to permanent residence); not confirmed in an official text and possibly outdated. Founding text (Immigration Act Cap. 4:02 and Immigration Regulations) and start date not found. No official counts found.

programs.name: Oman residence for owners of property in Integrated Tourism Complexes (نظام تملك العقارات في المجمعات السياحية المتكاملة; Royal Decree 12/2006 art. 8)
programs.notes: Non-Omanis may buy built units or plots in licensed Integrated Tourism Complexes; the owner of a built unit and first-degree relatives may be granted residence (Royal Decree 12/2006 art. 8). Under the 2007 executive regulations the residence is for two years, renewed automatically every two years for six years; owners of a building plot get a two-year multiple-entry investor visa until construction is completed. No minimum price is set in the texts read. 'launched' is the decree's in-force date (date of issue, 19 Feb 2006; published 1 Mar 2006). Separate from omn-investor-residence (2021, which also has OMR 250,000/500,000 property categories under MD 58/2022). Amendments (MD 109/2022) and current practice not read; status left empty. No official counts found. In scope under decision 15 (refined): buying property is in even without a minimum price; the purchase rule is recorded with the amount unset.

events.quote: mediante la donación o inversión para la ejecución de programas o proyectos orientados a dinamizar la economía del país opten por una residencia definitiva

events.title: Sri Lanka sets up the Golden Paradise Visa for investors
events.description: Immigration circular 01/2022/VISA lays down the Golden Paradise Visa: a 10-year residence visa for a foreigner who deposits at least US$100,000 in a Golden Paradise account in Sri Lanka (US$50,000 to be kept after the first year), for the investor, spouse and children under 16.
events.quote: Following procedure should be followed when granting the Golden Paradise Visa

events.title: China issues the measures on permanent residence for foreigners, with a route for direct investors
events.description: MPS and MFA Order 74 sets out permanent residence for foreign direct investors (three years of stable investment, US$0.5-2 million depending on sector and region), in force on promulgation.
events.quote: 《外国人在中国永久居留审批管理办法》已于2003年12月13日经国务院批准，现予发布施行。

events.title: Macau decree on residence for investors (DL 14/95/M) takes effect, replacing DL 3/84/M
events.description: Decreto-Lei 14/95/M creates incentives for investors, managers and specialised technicians to settle; relevant investments include at least MOP 1 million placed in real estate or productive assets. It revokes DL 3/84/M, under which investor residence applications were already pending.
events.quote: O presente diploma entra em vigor no dia 1 de Abril de 1995.

events.title: Macau replaces the investor residence decree with Administrative Regulation 3/2005
events.description: RA 3/2005 sets residence for relevant investments, investment plans, managers and technicians, and a separate property-purchase route (MOP 1 million property plus MOP 500,000 deposit); in force on publication (BO 14 of 4 Apr 2005).
events.quote: O presente diploma entra em vigor no dia da sua publicação.

events.title: Macau suspends residence through property purchase
events.description: RA 7/2007 suspends art. 1(4) and art. 3 of RA 3/2005 (property buyers) from 4 Apr 2007; renewals, family extensions and applications already filed are not affected.
events.quote: É suspensa a eficácia dos artigos 1.º, alínea 4), e 3.º do Regulamento Administrativo n.º 3/2005.

events.title: Indian Cabinet approves permanent residency status for foreign investors
events.description: The Union Cabinet approves a scheme of Permanent Residency Status for foreign investors investing at least Rs 10 crore within 18 months or Rs 25 crore within 36 months and employing at least 20 resident Indians a year.
events.quote: has approved the scheme for grant of Permanent Residency Status (PRS) to foreign investors

events.title: Viet Nam ties investor visas and residence cards to capital contributed
events.description: Law 51/2019/QH14 takes effect, splitting the investor visa into ĐT1-ĐT4 by capital contributed (VND 100bn, 50bn, 3bn thresholds) with temporary residence cards of up to 10, 5 and 3 years.
events.location: p. 61, preamble of the consolidated text
events.quote: có hiệu lực kể từ ngày 01 tháng 7 năm 2020

events.title: Viet Nam's Law on entry, exit, transit and residence of foreigners takes effect
events.description: Law 47/2014/QH13 of 16 Jun 2014, the law later amended to set investor classes by capital, takes effect.
events.location: p. 61, preamble of the consolidated text
events.quote: có hiệu lực kể từ ngày 01 tháng 01 năm 2015

events.title: Sarawak tightens S-MM2H: RM500,000 fixed deposit, age 30+, 30 days a year
events.description: The Sarawak tourism minister announces that from 1 Jan 2025 applicants must be 30 or older, open a fixed deposit of RM500,000 per application in a Sarawak bank and stay at least 30 days a year.
events.quote: Effective Jan 1 next year, applications for the Sarawak-Malaysia My Second Home (S-MM2H) programme must comply with new requirements

events.title: Ukraine's Law on Immigration, with an investor category, enters into force
events.description: The Law on Immigration of 7 June 2001 enters into force; investors of at least USD 100,000 are one of the categories eligible for an immigration permit within the quota.
events.quote: 07.08.2001 Набрання чинності

events.title: Ukraine adopts the Law on Immigration with an investor category
events.description: The first edition lists persons who made a foreign investment of at least USD 100,000 among the immigration quota categories; the law enters into force one month after publication.
events.quote: Цей Закон набирає чинності через місяць з дня його опублікування

events.title: Georgia's new aliens law creates an investment residence permit
events.description: The Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons enters into force, with an investment residence permit for an investment of at least GEL 300,000.
events.quote: This law shall enter into force from 1 September 2014.

events.title: Georgia raises the investment residence threshold to USD 300,000 and adds real estate
events.description: Law No 4741 of 30 May 2019 (published 5.6.2019) sets the investment residence permit at USD 300,000 (investment or real estate), 5-year validity and a path to unlimited residence; date is publication, from the history note; Law 4741 itself is not stored.
events.quote: Law of Georgia No 4741 of 30 May 2019 – website, 5.6.2019

events.title: Georgia publishes Law 3602 adding a residence permit for property owners (USD 35,000)
events.description: Law No 3602 of 8 May 2015 (published 15.5.2015) adds Article 15(j): a short-term residence permit for owners of real property worth more than USD 35,000; date is publication, from the history note; Law 3602 itself is not stored, so its in-force date is unknown.
events.quote: Law of Georgia No 3602 of 8 May 2015 – website, 15.5.2015

events.title: Georgia's Law on the Legal Status of Aliens enters into force
events.description: The 2014 law into which the property-owner permit was later inserted enters into force.
events.quote: This Law shall enter into force from 1 September 2014.

events.title: Georgia raises the property-owner residence threshold to USD 150,000
events.description: Law No 863 of 26 June 2025 (published 1.7.2025) raises the Article 15(j) threshold from USD 100,000 to USD 150,000; date is publication, from the history note; Law 863 itself is not stored, so its in-force date is unknown.
events.quote: Law of Georgia No 863 of 26 June 2025 – website, 1.7.2025

events.title: Russia's criteria for investor residence permits enter into force
events.description: Government Decree No. 2573 of 31 December 2022, setting four investment criteria for a residence permit without a temporary residence permit, enters into force.
events.quote: Настоящее постановление вступает в силу с 11 января 2023 г.

events.title: Uzbekistan grants residence permits to foreign real-estate buyers
events.description: Presidential Decree UP-5611 (in force 06.01.2019) gives citizens of listed countries a residence permit on buying real estate worth USD 100,000-400,000 depending on the region.
events.quote: Дата вступления в силу 06.01.2019

events.title: Uzbekistan cuts the Tashkent property threshold to USD 300,000
events.description: Decree UP-101 of 8 April 2022 (published 09.04.2022) lowers the threshold for Tashkent city and region from USD 400,000 to USD 300,000.
events.quote: в редакции Указа Президента Республики Узбекистан от 8 апреля 2022 года № УП-101

events.title: Azerbaijan adds government securities as a ground for temporary residence
events.description: The State Migration Service reports an amendment to the Migration Code adding temporary residence for holders of government securities of at least AZN 100,000 (date is the news item; the amending law's date is not given).
events.quote: a new category of case has been added to the conditions for obtaining a temporary residence permit

events.title: Montenegro's parliament adopts a EUR 150,000 minimum for property-based residence
events.description: Parliament adopts amendments to the Law on Foreigners requiring a real-estate transfer tax base of at least EUR 150,000 for temporary residence on the basis of property (EU/EEA/Swiss nationals exempt); in force on the eighth day after publication. Date is adoption; the publication (and so in-force) date is not stored.
events.quote: dana 31.decembra 2025. godine

events.title: Montenegro rewrites the property-based residence article and repeals the property-value decree
events.description: Parliament replaces art. 54 of the Law on Foreigners (temporary residence for use of owned real property) and repeals the 2015 decree on the type and value of property owned by foreigners. Date is adoption by Parliament; the in-force date is not stored.
events.quote: dana 24. februara 2016. godine

events.title: Andorra makes passive residence conditional on a EUR 400,000 investment
events.description: Llei 9/2012 of 31 May 2012, in force on publication in the BOPA of 27 June 2012, requires holders of residence without gainful activity to invest at least EUR 400,000 in Andorran assets (art. 96).
events.quote: Aquesta Llei entra en vigor el mateix dia de ser publicada al Butlletí Oficial del Principat d’Andorra.

events.title: South Africa publishes the Immigration Act 2002, creating the business permit for investors
events.description: Section 15 lets the Department issue a business permit to a foreigner intending to establish or invest in a business, provided he invests the prescribed financial or capital contribution; s. 27(c) gives permanent residence on a similar basis. Date is the Gazette publication; commencement was set by proclamation (not stored).
events.quote: intending to establish, or invest in. a business in the Republic

events.title: Zambia Development Agency Act 2006 ties a USD 250,000 investment to a residence permit (date under the long title)
events.description: Section 65(1) entitles an investor who invests at least USD 250,000 and employs at least 200 persons to a self-employment or resident permit. Date printed under the long title; the Act came into force by statutory instrument (not stored).
events.quote: shall be entitled to a self employment permit or resident permit

events.title: Immigration and Deportation Act 2010 creates the investor's permit
events.description: Section 29 provides for an investor's permit for a foreigner who invests a prescribed financial or capital contribution or holds a ZDA investment licence; the Act commenced on 17 September 2010.
events.quote: is a person who will invest or has invested a prescribed ﬁnancial or capital contribution in the business

events.title: Oman lets non-Omanis own property in Integrated Tourism Complexes, with residence for owners
events.description: Royal Decree 12/2006 issues the system for non-Omani ownership of real estate in integrated tourism complexes; art. 8 allows residence for a non-Omani owner of a built property and first-degree relatives. In force from the date of issue; published in Official Gazette 810 on 1 Mar 2006.
events.location: art. 4 of the decree; art. 8 of the system
events.quote: يجوز منح غير العماني المالك لعقار مبني بغرض السكن أو الاستثمار، إقامة له ولأقاربه من الدرجة الأولى

events.title: Executive regulations of the ITC system set residence rules
events.description: Ministerial Decision 191/2007 (issued 19 Sep 2007, published 1 Oct 2007, in force the following day) sets the procedure: application to the Royal Oman Police, grant within seven working days, two-year residence renewed automatically to six years.
events.quote: ينشر هذا القرار في الجريدة الرسمية، ويعمل به من اليوم التالي لتاريخ نشره
